# Nationwide Haul

> Nationwide Haul is an authorized dealer of new and used semi-trailers, semi-trucks and commercial vehicles, founded in 2012 by Derek and Tracy Madon. It offers in-house financing through NEF NOW (40+ lenders, credit scores as low as 500, startup programs), semi-trailer leasing (12–72 months) and rental (6-month minimum), service and repair, free DOT inspections for life on equipment it sells, and delivery anywhere in the United States. Locations: Lakeland, FL (headquarters), Pompano Beach, FL and Macon, GA.

Key facts:
- Main phone: (877) 559-7039 · Email: operations@nationwidehaul.com · Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm ET
- Sells to owner-operators, fleets, dealers and municipalities across the United States; inventory is shared across all three locations and delivered nationwide
- Trailer types: dry vans, reefer (refrigerated) trailers, flatbeds, dump trailers, lowboy / RGN trailers; trucks include Autocar yard trucks and vocational trucks
- Authorized brands: MAC Trailer, Vanguard National, Dorsey Trailers, Pitts Trailers, XL Specialized, WADE Services, CIE Manufacturing, Autocar
- Government: Sourcewell (via MAC Trailer) and Florida Sheriffs Association (FSA) Cooperative vendor; FLAGFA member
- Financing: soft-pull pre-qualification in minutes, decisions in 24–48 business hours, 20–40% down improves approval for challenged credit
- Live inventory: https://inventory.nationwidehaul.com/

## Trailers for sale
- [All trailer types](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/)
- [Dry vans](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/dry-vans/): 48 and 53 ft enclosed vans; plate vs. sheet-and-post, doors and floors explained
- [Reefer trailers](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/reefer-trailers/): refrigerated trailers for produce, frozen and pharma freight
- [Flatbed trailers](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/flatbed-trailers/): steel and aluminum flatbeds, step decks, drop decks
- [Dump trailers](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/dump-trailers/): half-round, frame and frameless MAC dumps
- [Lowboy trailers](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/trailers/lowboy-trailers/): RGN and fixed-neck heavy haul

## Buying, financing and leasing
- [Financing](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/financing/): NEF NOW truck and trailer financing, bad credit and startups
- [Leasing & rental](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/lease/): lease vs. rental terms, DOT-inspected units, 24–48 hour deployment
- [Pre-owned warranty](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/perks/warranty/): Class 8 trucks up to 10 years / under 900K miles; used reefer unit warranty
- [Free DOT inspections for life](https://www.nationwidehaul.com/perks/dot-inspections/)
